scenarios.name: Export Timeout
scenarios.description: Simulates a timeout when exporting a large batch of items
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Agent should reduce batch size and retry
scenarios.expectedRecovery: Split into smaller batches of 25 items

scenarios.name: Authentication Failure
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Agent should escalate with auth error context
scenarios.expectedRecovery: Escalate to human with credential refresh instructions

scenarios.name: Schema Mismatch
scenarios.description: Pricing tool returns string instead of float
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Validation should reject, retry should include schema mismatch details
scenarios.expectedRecovery: Second attempt with type coercion succeeds

scenarios.name: Partial Import Failure
scenarios.description: Import succeeds for some items but fails for others

trigger.failureReason: Item already exists with different template

scenarios.expectedBehavior: Report partial success with specific failed items
scenarios.expectedRecovery: Offer to retry failed items with overwrite mode

scenarios.name: Circular Dependency Detection
scenarios.description: Items reference each other creating a cycle
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Detect cycle during analysis, warn but allow transfer
scenarios.expectedRecovery: Transfer in dependency order with cycle broken at arbitrary point

scenarios.name: Missing Parent Item
scenarios.description: Child item references a parent not in the transfer set
scenarios.expectedBehavior: Validation error, block transfer without parent
scenarios.expectedRecovery: Suggest including parent or transferring to existing location

metadata.purpose: Deliberate failure injection scenarios for testing agent recovery
metadata.usage: Pass scenario ID to demo script to trigger specific failure mode
